conditions.evidence: controlled gradual cerebral ischemia in pig
conditions.label: gradual cerebral ischemia

output.population: 11 animals (juvenile pigs), split into a sedation group and an ischemia group
output.summary: Recordings from juvenile pigs surgically instrumented and monitored under sedation states with isoflurane, fentanyl and propofol, followed by episodes of gradual ischemia and recovery, as a model of corticothalamic communication.
